The design of the racks is terrible in that they are mostly non adjustable and the tines holding the dishes and glassware are so tightly placed that if a dish is anything but perfectly flat or a glass is round or irregular, they cannot easily be loaded. Cereal bowls and gently curved plates cannot nest at all. Why not have a hinged set of tines/holders interspersed into the fixed set? My Kitchen Aid had this. When up, many flat dishes fit. There was NO indication on any printed materials that an in depth guide was available on line. Why not? There appears to be a disconnect with your design team/ outward facing service and the consumer. ( The helpline people were helpful but we should not have to use a helpline.)

Sentence (English): I had a different brand dishwasher that had served me well for 12 years.
Comments (English): [ Exceeded my expectations ] || ---------------- || I had a different brand dishwasher that had served me well for 12 years. My father and sister both raved about their Bosch dishwashers. Initially I was hesitant about the top third rack, but I am amazed how many items I end up putting there such as measuring spoons, measuring cups, and odd-sized kitchen gadgets. Sentence (English): I removed the entire Bilton gas oven from the stovetop and installed a dishwasher.
Comments (English): I removed the entire Bilton gas oven from the stovetop and installed a dishwasher. I also purchased a new gas stove cheaply at a secondhand market in a nearby apartment complex and installed it. I had no particular desire to upgrade to an induction stove because I'd experienced inconveniences with my existing gas stove, and I'd heard that installing an induction stove on top of the dishwasher would require a step up, making it impossible to fit perfectly. I debated a lot before ordering, whether to call Samchully to shut off the gas or to hire a dishwasher technician first. I decided to order the dishwasher first. The technician came that day, disassembled and disposed of the oven, and I paid a 50,000 won disposal fee. They also blocked the gas pipe (they told me not to open the intermediate valve just in case. It's better to be careful). They also completed the basic dishwasher installation. The gas stove cord is behind the dishwasher, so the technician might not be able to move it during installation. They kindly advised me to call them when the technician arrives, and they'd come nearby. I'm using it as a built-in appliance, but I don't think I'll be staying in this house for long and don't really need high-end features, so I chose one with automatic door opening and high-temperature sterilization. I've had no issues using it so far. It's incredibly convenient and great when I have a lot of dishes. I rinse them with water to remove any food residue, and they come out clean. The only downside is that the buttons are touch-sensitive, so I find myself constantly pressing them while cooking. The door also opens slightly automatically. I don't like to keep the door closed, so I keep it slightly ajar. That means I keep hitting the start button with my belly. Anyway, I bought it for a low price and I'm using it very well. The ivory color blends in seamlessly with my home.

Sentence (English): Ordered a replacement for our 10 year old same model that was giving error code for draining, no matter the tricks tried to get it to work.
Comments (English): [ Bosch's low end model, but still works fine ] || ---------------- || Ordered a replacement for our 10 year old same model that was giving error code for draining, no matter the tricks tried to get it to work. It was clearly draining fine when it did run, as there was no blockage that could be found. Previous to this we had a 500 series that sold me on Bosch appliances. Chose a lower model Ascenta after the 500 series wore through parts from our then household of eight after about 8 years of teenager abuse (including replacing the door), since money was tight at the time. Installation was the same simple procedure for nearly all dishwashers (I've installed probably six over many relocations), but even more so with the Bosch. New to me was an included rear installing power cord, all previous models being hardwired at the front. Lucky for me, Best Buy included the connection box for hardwire installs since our power outlet is a good distance away from the unit. Installing that box was easy too, routing the cord from an adjacent cabinet as instructed. This is smart, so that if there is an issue with the box connection it can be accessed without having to pull out the dishwasher. I had to purchase a hose type connection for the hot water line, since Bosch switched to a different connecting method. This was an $8 part at the local home monster store. Only quibble I have with this newer version is that the sound level has increased, thus subtracting a star. Ten years ago when we went from the 500 to the Ascenta line, the sound level was about the same. It's still quiet compared to every non-Bosch dishwasher, just slightly noisier. Might be due to the plastic tub base now having the motor(s) assembly bolted onto the base. Previous model had it as all one cast piece (double checked on the old one to verify). Assume this is to make servicing easier. The Ascenta line is Bosch's lower tier model, with a plastic base and stainless upper tub, including two racks. The 300 series and higher have three tiers, which looks quite useful, but just too pricey for a lowly paid scientist (science does not pay, kids) still getting the last kid through college! As for functioning, well it cleans like only a Bosch can do. The wife says it cleans better than our old one. Now that it's only us at home, I assume it will last 10+ years before we have to replace or upgrade to the fancier model.

Comments (English): [ Works great and runs quietly! ] || ---------------- || Have had it for about a month and love it. Runs super quietly and dishes come out pretty much as dry as any other dishwasher. Rack system takes a little bit of getting used to, but is flexible enough for our needs. Wish the bottom rack was just a little bit more adjustable as sometimes we have trouble fitting in our bigger items (big pyrex baking dishes, baking sheets, cutting boards, and larger pots always feel a little awkward to squeeze in, they always seem to perch a little unstably on top of all the slanted tines).I have seen other reviews complain about a faint asphalt smell while the dishwasher is running; we noticed that too but it went away after a week or two.The button system is a bit confusing sometimes; sometimes I press the wrong buttons and it's hard to reset the system so I can start a new load. I also wish there was a clearer indicator when the dishwasher was done running; sometimes other people will open the dishwasher mid-cycle and forget to resume it, and it's hard to tell if the dishwasher was interrupted mid-cycle or if it had completed already because in both cases the screen flashes a timer. And of course, I wish there were more options in white. If there was a white model with a bar handle instead of a pocket handle I would have gotten that one instead. All of these are minor comments, all in all, we're very happy with the dishwasher!

I have been pleasantly surprised; I was skeptical at first that items on the third rack would still get cleaned properly, but we have tried loading some really gunky utensils without prerinsing them and they have still come out spotless. Wish the bottom rack was just a little bit more adjustable as sometimes we have trouble fitting in our bigger items (big pyrex baking dishes, baking sheets, cutting boards, and larger pots always feel a little awkward to squeeze in, they always seem to perch a little unstably on top of all the slanted tines).I have seen other reviews complain about a faint asphalt smell while the dishwasher is running; we noticed that too but it went away after a week or two.The button system is a bit confusing sometimes; sometimes I press the wrong buttons and it's hard to reset the system so I can start a new load. I also wish there was a clearer indicator when the dishwasher was done running; sometimes other people will open the dishwasher mid-cycle and forget to resume it, and it's hard to tell if the dishwasher was interrupted mid-cycle or if it had completed already because in both cases the screen flashes a timer. And of course, I wish there were more options in white. If there was a white model with a bar handle instead of a pocket handle I would have gotten that one instead. All of these are minor comments, all in all, we're very happy with the dishwasher!

Sentence (English): Have had it for about a month and love it.
Comments (English): [ Works great and runs quietly! ] || ---------------- || Have had it for about a month and love it. Runs super quietly and dishes come out pretty much as dry as any other dishwasher. Rack system takes a little bit of getting used to, but is flexible enough for our needs. Third rack feels like a huge luxury. I have been pleasantly surprised; I was skeptical at first that items on the third rack would still get cleaned properly, but we have tried loading some really gunky utensils without prerinsing them and they have still come out spotless. Wish the bottom rack was just a little bit more adjustable as sometimes we have trouble fitting in our bigger items (big pyrex baking dishes, baking sheets, cutting boards, and larger pots always feel a little awkward to squeeze in, they always seem to perch a little unstably on top of all the slanted tines). I have seen other reviews complain about a faint asphalt smell while the dishwasher is running; we noticed that too but it went away after a week or two. The button system is a bit confusing sometimes; sometimes I press the wrong buttons and it's hard to reset the system so I can start a new load. I also wish there was a clearer indicator when the dishwasher was done running; sometimes other people will open the dishwasher mid-cycle and forget to resume it, and it's hard to tell if the dishwasher was interrupted mid-cycle or if it had completed already because in both cases the screen flashes a timer. And of course, I wish there were more options in white. If there was a white model with a bar handle instead of a pocket handle I would have gotten that one instead. All of these are minor comments, all in all, we're very happy with the dishwasher!

Sentence (English): So far OK but not not as good as my previous Kitchen Aid dishwasher which was 20 years old.
Comments (English): [ So far OK but .  ] || ---------------- || So far OK but not not as good as my previous Kitchen Aid dishwasher which was 20 years old. On the plus side the dishes come out clean which after all is the primary purpose for a dishwasher. On the nice but unimportant to me is how quiet the machine is, in fact maybe too quiet as you can't tell it's running without looking at the lights on the door. In the category of there must be a reason why this changed but I wish it hadn't there are 2 things. First the normal cycle with heat drying increased a a full hour to 3 hours. The second and most annoying is the layout of the racks. There is less space and items don't fit in as well and stay in place as in my old unit. For example I used to be able to get 2 rows of dinner plates across the bottom rack with no problem. Now the 2 rows barely fit and the front row of plates tend to roll back into the back row if you barely breathe on them. There are also space issues to with the top rack as far as putting things in. And small plates put in the the center strip tend to roll off to either side because of its design. Over all the washing is good but the racks make it much less convienent. I would only recommend this machine with reservations.

Sentence (English): Immediately after installation we noticed the door on our dish washer was tight, and made some subtle creaking sounds.
Comments (English): [ Warranty Expires, Door Falls Off! ] || ---------------- || Immediately after installation we noticed the door on our dish washer was tight, and made some subtle creaking sounds. The installer assured us it was just because it was new, and promised it would loosen over time as the springs stretched. We had the installer back a few weeks later to correct another issue (third party installers are a joke, too, but that's a matter for another review), and once again we were assured the door was perfectly normal. While the door never got noticeably worse, it also never loosened up. Then not long after the warranty expired the door hinges broke completely, and the swing edge of the door nearly fell completely to the floor. It was technically still attached, but not by much, and it was no longer functional. Clearly there was some sort of manufacturing defect at play here. Then we learned that dishwasher doors are not designed to be replaced, so there was no fix and the entire unit had to be scrapped. Needless to say we did not buy another Kitchenaid. Appliances in general aren't made the way they used to be, but the cheapest dishwasher in the world should last more than a year and a half.

Sentence (English): My spouse ultimately prevailed in his struggle to install the dishwasher, thanks to his extensive collection of tools—but said "I don't know how anyone could do this without a machine shop".
Comments (English): [ Difficult installation ] || ---------------- || My spouse ultimately prevailed in his struggle to install the dishwasher, thanks to his extensive collection of tools—but said "I don't know how anyone could do this without a machine shop". Installation took about 8 hours over two days. The dishwasher itself works very well. Just be prepared to spend the weekend installing it. or pay someone who won't take as much care with your cabinets as you would.There is no installation material supplied, except the drain hose. You need electrical skills to hardwire the power cable into the junction box on the dishwasher. The plumbing is simpler. Mounting was the biggest challenge—top mount is best if you have a wood countertop, but we have soapstone. Mounting brackets can be placed at two points on each side of the tub frame. The lower site lacks a hole in the frame where a screw can go through, so it's impossible to use the "hidden mount" option. There are videos online showing how to install a GE dishwasher that utilize this hole, which appears to have been eliminated—to make installation harder? The upper bracket location has an huge hole at this height—larger than the screw head, so you'd have to put in a washer. The only side-mount option is to leave the bracket protruding and screw it into the side of the cabinet facing. But if your cabinets are exactly 24 inches apart the domed (why? ) head of the supplied screws prevents the door from closing. You must chisel out a place for the bracket in your cabinet, or file down the screw head, or both. What a kluged-up solution.

Sentence (English): We had an older model higher end Bosche that we were replacing after 10 years of use.
Comments (English): [ Dishwasher replacement ] || ---------------- || We had an older model higher end Bosche that we were replacing after 10 years of use. It had rusted rungs but was still functioning ok, just not getting the dishes as cleaned off as we would like. Pros: The new Bosch has a third wire rack that we like for smaller items and odd shaped utensils. One of the three racks has adjustable height, which is great, and many of the racks tines can be folded down for odd shaped items. It is extremely quiet when running, and the ding when done is nice. Cons:The new Bosch is lighter weight overall, and the racks are more flimsy than the old one. The plastic silverware caddy(s) are half the former weight as well, and the dividers are too low, so the silverware doesn't stand up well. The middle rack has a strange indented handle which gets in the way of loading the dishes. It should have been straight across like the last one. The soap dispenser feels like it's backwards - it makes it hard to load soap unless you only use pods. We don't see any difference in the amount of food we have to spray off before loading the dishes. It still bakes on dried food that it doesn't wash off properly. Overall, it looks nice, works at least as good as the last Bosch we had, and is slightly quieter. We just were expecting better washing performance, and more substantial materials. This doesn't feel like something that will last ten years. But compared to other options out there, we are happy enough with our choice.

Sentence (English): My mother said that she wanted to have a dishwasher, but there was no space for the opening and closing part of the lower cabinet, and she would never give up on drawers.
Comments (English): [ I wish I had a dishwasher, but I don't have a lower cabinet. ] || ---------------- || My mother said that she wanted to have a dishwasher, but there was no space for the opening and closing part of the lower cabinet, and she would never give up on drawers. So 6 people was the only option, and when I saw the real thing at the store, he said he wouldn't buy it because it was small. Then, after a while, the mother was suddenly hospitalized, and the father, who had to wash the dishes, which he had never done in his life, came to Hyeonta and bought a 6-seater. When I actually used it, I wanted to use it better than I thought, but my mom still didn't like it. There is noise! Since it is for 6 people, the function is different from that for 12 people. But it's like not having to wash the dishes. Even though you only use the fast mode because of concerns about electricity bills, it can be washed with hot water, so the washing condition (washed bowl photo) is good and dries quickly. It must be thanks to the residual heat and the automatic fan function. oh noisy! Even now, mom is still using the dishwasher. I (daughter) made a reservation for 14 people. Long live the dishwasher.
Comments (Original): [ 식기세척기를 갖고싶긴하지만 하부장 여 ] || ---------------- || 식기세척기를 갖고싶긴하지만 하부장 여닫이부분은 공간이 안 나오고, 서랍은 절대 포기 못한다는 엄마였다. 그래서 6인용이 유일한 옵션이었고, 매장에서 실물을 보니 작다고 성에 안찬다며 사지않겠다고 하셨다. 그러고 얼마 후, 급작스레 엄마는 입원을 하게되었고, 평생 안하던 설거지를 하게된 아빠가 현타가 와서 6인용을 구매하게 되었다. 막상 사용하니 생각보다 알차게 들어가서 잘 쓰겠다 싶었는데 엄마는 그래도 탐탁찮아하셨으나 다음날 몸이 피곤하다며 스스로 사용하는 엄마를 보았다ㅋㅋㅋ소음이 있다! 6인용이라 아무래도 12인용과 기능이 차이난다. 그러나 설거지를 안 해도 되는것은 같다. 전기세 걱정으로 급속모드만 사용하시는데도 뜨거운 물로 세척이 되기에 세척상태(세척된 그릇 사진)도 좋고 금세 마른다. 잔열과 자동송풍기능 덕이리라. 아잉 시끄러! 하면서도 지금도 엄마는 세척기를 사용중이다. 본인은(딸) 14인용을 예약해두었다. 식세기 만세.

Sentence (English): What a big change.
Comments (English): [ Excellent change of Dishwasher ] || ---------------- || What a big change. It had a dishwasher between 12 - 15 years old, which each time began to leave the dishes, cutlery, etc., dirtier. I definitely recommend this dishwasher.

Pero no solo limpia bien, que parece que deba ser una obviedad, me han sorprendido muchas funciones a las que no estaba acostumbrado, como por ejemplo, la 3a bandeja para cubiertos, que es ideal para que todos queden siempre impolutos, o el hecho de que todas las bandejas sean regulables en altura y con varillas también modulables, pudiendo quedar totalmente abatidas según lo que debas poner. Sentence (English): With the slow and ultimate demise of our 18 year old Maytag dishwasher I only wanted a basic replacement that didn't need a bunch of "bells and whistles".
Comments (English): [ Good machine with a few drawbacks ] || ---------------- || With the slow and ultimate demise of our 18 year old Maytag dishwasher I only wanted a basic replacement that didn't need a bunch of "bells and whistles". That is exactly what this dishwasher is, basic. I purchased this online through Home Depot and now wish I had gone to a store to actually view the different models and their features. What I hadn't given consideration to is the two wash racks. On the old Maytag both the top and bottom racks had rows and spacings of different widths thus accomodating larger or smaller items. This unit is very, very basic in that respect such that both top and bottom have very uniform unimaginitive rows of uniform depth. Maybe in a more advanced, read expensive, model this wouldn't be so. Had I gone to a store and examined the interior at the least I would have looked at other models. Now I will say that it does a very good job of cleaning and though not quite as quiet as the Maytag, the 55db rating makes this a quiet dishwasher still. My biggest complaint is that it doesn't dry thoroughly. I have now run 6 or 7 cycles and every time and the dry cycle has completed I have had to hand towel dry plates, silverware, and glasses before they can be put into the cupboard. I called Whirlpool and they had a service tech come out within a day but he found nothing wrong or that could be changed or fixed, claiming that he has had other people claim the same results. He did say that the plastic interiors, which this one has, cannot stand up to the drying heat of the metal interior models. But my former Maytag also had a plastic interior and did a far better job at drying - even after 18 years of use. A good unit for the money but "buyer beware". It wasn't that I was trying to be cheap! I just wanted a basic machine but had I been aware of these two deficiencies I would have spent more money for better drying and loading qualities.

Sentence (English): I've owned this dishwasher for a month and a half.
Comments (English): [ Not worth the price ] || ---------------- || I've owned this dishwasher for a month and a half. Initially I loved it. Everything came out sparkling clean and almost completely dry. After only about a week, everything started to have a film on it even though I used rinse aid and only Cascade brand tabs. We've ran empty afresh loads to clean the dishwasher but are still dealing with the film. We also completely rinse every speck of food, etc off of everything before placing in dishwasher. The occasions when just a small bit was left on, it would end up crusted to usually a different thing like a drinking glass. Another unusual thing is that knives and pans that I used to be able to run through our old dishwasher without a problem are getting rust spots on them after being ran through this dishwasher. These issues are annoying, especially for the high price of this dishwasher. The 3 racks are nice because more dishes now fit in the dishwasher (I think). We are still getting used to how to arrangement everything. I would not recommend to others but it is an OK dishwasher.

These baskets can be raised, or in the case of the cutlery basket, it can be removed if necessary. It has a wide variety of programs (auto, eco, turbo, express, etc) along with many options that complement them. This, together with the fact that it can be controlled from the mobile application, makes it very easy to control. To improve the duration of some programs (they can reach almost 4 hours), but you know, if you want to save energy (this model has B certification) it is a happy price to pay. It has some technology that I really like, such as the steam wash for the dishes, or the mobile spray arms, along with the aesthetics (mine has a stainless steel finish). In short, a very good purchase and worth every euro spent.

Resumiendo, una muy buena compra y que merece cada euro gastado.

Sentence (English): I live in California.
Comments (English): [ YAY Bosch and Install requires planning ahead ] || ---------------- || I live in California. I needed a new dishwasher but waited hoping Costco might bring in Bosch. Specifically I would like to address all the drama and poor reviews around delivery and installation. My delivery and installation took all of 30 minutes, it was extremely professional and efficient by Pacific West Home Improvement. Here is why: I have a house built in 1972. Before the dishwasher installation, I had a new faucet and garbage disposal installed. The 1972 angle stop valves had slow leaks despite visually looking sound. I had those replaced $200+. The electrical outlet was up to code in PLACEMENT meaning it was adjacent to the dishwasher, in the cupboard area under the sink and not BEHIND the dishwasher. CA electrical code has changed in the last couple of years so I had the outlet receptacle replaced to code which is all GFI in kitchens, even behind the refrigerator. GFI outlet for dishwasher, switched receptacle GFI for garbage disposal. $375, After reading all the complaints, I was concerned and did some research. Clearly the people complaining had not followed the instructions on the Costco website instructing them to take responsibility to have their electrical, plumbing, and air gap issues worked out prior to installation. Always interesting when adults expect other people to be responsible for their poor planning.

Sentence (English): Great dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ Great, but also not ] || ---------------- || Great dishwasher. It has some great features, until it isn't great. I know lots of people love the 3rd rack at the top, I'm not a huge fan. It takes up valuable space for taller items in the top rack. If what is up there is very flat all the dirt just sits on top of it because there is nothing spraying down on it. Also the wheel bases for the bottom rack are too big so even though the sound rating is low, it is interspersed with a very loud whack every time the sprayer bar turns. I feel like for the price I paid it only marginally does a better job than the 20 year old dishwasher it replaced. Unless you choose the 3+hour cycle every time. It's a dishwasher, it does a job. GE should have fixed the wheel problem by now. Definitely call if you have the same problem and make them come fix it. Ours hasn't yet of this review. The whacking will cause problems with the sprayer bar to separate and you don't want that even if you can handle the sound!
